origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 尃 (spread out) as the sound: to strike and grapple with the hands.

ety.hint: A fist 九 holding a pebble 丶

origin.says: Origin unclear: an old dictionary reading sees a flipped 仄 (tilt), something that tilts and rolls, hence a ball; another links it to 夗 (curled up). The likeness to 九 (nine) with a dot is a coincidence.
origin.src: CUHK; Wiktionary; Dong Chinese; web search

栋.def: ridge-beam; the main support of a house

origin.says: Simplified from 棟: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 東 (east) as the sound, now 东: the ridge-beam of a house, also a counter for buildings.

栋.name: ridge beam

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 亥 (twelfth earthly branch) as the sound: what the mouth does when you cough.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 崔 (lofty) as the sound: to press a person, to hurry them.

遏.def: to curb, to check, to stop, to suppress

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 曷 (why) as the sound: to stop someone's going, to check, to suppress.

遏.name: curb

逗.def: to entice, to tempt; to arouse, to stir

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 豆 (bean) as the sound: to stop and linger; later to tease, to amuse.

逗.name: tease

甩.def: to throw away, to fling, to discard

origin.says: A late character made from 用 (use) with its last stroke bent into a hook swinging out to the side: to fling, to throw away, to swing.

甩.name: toss away

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound: animal fat.

扒.def: to scratch, to dig up; to crouch, to crawl

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 八 (eight) as the sound: using the hands to scratch, dig or cling.

扒.name: dig by hand

origin.says: Origin unsettled: one reading sees a small bent stream of water, which fits the early forms best; an old dictionary reading sees a plant curling as it sprouts; another a knife. Borrowed very early for the second of the ten heavenly stems, 'second, B'.

乙.name: grade b
乙.in: 吃艺亿忆挖迄乞疙屹乾

ety.hint: Chalk made from black 黑 earth 土

origin.says: 黑 (black) as the sound, and also for its meaning, plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: the black stick of soot and glue ground for writing, ink.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 疌 (quick) as the sound: to seize quickly, nimble, and a victory won.

喘.def: to pant, to gasp, to breathe heavily

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 耑 (sprout, tip) as the sound: breathing hard through the mouth, to pant.

喘.name: pant

origin.says: 虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 夆 (meet) as the sound: bee or wasp. A fuller old variant is 蠭.
解 (to untie) as the sound plus 虫 (creature) for the meaning: the crab, an armoured creature you take apart to eat. Once written with the parts side by side.

ety.hint: A long 曼 plant 艹 ; 曼 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 曼 (long, stretched) as the sound and a hint of meaning: a plant that stretches out long, a vine or creeper.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound: the cassia or cinnamon tree, also osmanthus.

ety.hint: An envious 疾 woman 女; 疾 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 疾 (illness) as the sound: jealous, envious.
雨 (rain) for the meaning plus 每 (every) as the sound: mould from the damp rainy season. It replaced 黴 (微 faint as the sound + 黑 black).

挨.def: close by, near, next to, towards, against; to lean on; to wait

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 矣 (old particle) as the sound: to be next to, press against; also to suffer (a blow) or wait.

挨.name: lean close

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 昆 (elder brother) as the sound: a wooden stick, a club; by extension a rogue.

吼.def: to roar, to shout; to bark, to howl

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 孔 (hole) as the sound: a loud cry from the mouth, to roar.

吼.name: roar

翔.def: to soar, to hover, to glide

origin.says: 羊 (sheep) as the sound plus 羽 (feathers) for the meaning: to circle with wings spread, to soar.

翔.name: glide

仗.def: 1to rely upon; protector; to fight; war, weaponry

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 丈 (ten feet) as the sound: a person's weapon, then to rely on it, and to fight, a battle.

仗.name: battle

origin.says: 不 (not) over 正 (straight): not straight, crooked. A later form replacing an older complex character.
A variant of 气 (vapour, breath), set apart with one stroke less to write the borrowed word 'to beg'. The modern pieces (a top like 𠂉 plus 乙) are only a shape.
A drawing of a square well with its wooden frame on four sides: a well.

迪.def: to advance, to enlighten, to make progress

ety.hint: To walk 辶 with purpose 由

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 由 (from) as the sound: to walk the way, to lead on, to enlighten.

迪.name: enlighten

ety.hint: Two brothers 比 under the son 日

origin.says: Origin unclear. One reading sees an early form as a picture of an insect (as in 昆虫, insects); the old dictionary reads 日 (sun) + 比 (side by side): the sun the same every day, 'together'. Used for elder brother and descendants.

Shuowen: a 'buttocks' character (尸 body over a pedestal, now drawn like 共) as the sound plus 殳 (hand with a weapon): the sound of hitting. Another reading: hitting the rear. It came to mean the hall at the back, a palace hall.
𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 尊 (honor) as the sound: to sit on one's feet, to squat.

ety.hint: A person 又 standing 立 as straight as a knife 刂

origin.says: From 豎: one reading has 臤 (firm) for the meaning plus 豆 (vessel) as the sound: upright. The simplification shortened 臤 and put 立 (stand) in place of 豆.
Simplified from 壩: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 霸 (tyrant) as the sound: an earth dam. The simplified form swaps the sound part for 贝 (shell money).

ety.hint: The wood of a dying 丂 tree 木

origin.says: 木 (tree, wood) for the meaning plus 丂 (an old sound sign) as the sound: wood that has decayed.

ety.hint: A fire 火 in one's home 户

origin.says: Simplified from 爐: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 盧 as the sound: a furnace. The simplified form replaces 盧 with 户 (door), close in sound.

妆.def: adornment, make-up; to dress up, to use make-up

origin.says: Simplified from 妝: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 爿 (plank) as the sound, now written ⺦: a woman's adornment, make-up.

妆.name: make-up

驰.def: speed, haste; to run, to gallop

origin.says: Simplified from 馳: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 也 (also) as the sound; 馬 took its short form: to gallop.

驰.name: race

origin.says: Simplified from 蟻: 虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 義 (justice) as the sound, now its simplified form 义: the ant.
辰 (clam hoe) as the sound plus 口 (mouth) for the meaning: the lips. It replaces 脣 (with 月 flesh), an older variant.
Simplified from 鈴 (釒 became 钅): 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: a small metal bell.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 叔 (uncle) as the sound: the Sichuan pepper shrub, hence pepper and spicy plants.

濒.def: to approach; near, on the verge of

origin.says: Simplified from 瀕: a person 頁 (head) with feet 步 (step) at the edge of 氵 (water): on the brink, close to. 頁 became 页.

濒.name: brink

洒.def: to pour, to spill; to scatter, to shed; to wipe away

origin.says: 氵 (water) plus 西 (west) as the sound. This old character (to wash) took over 灑 (sprinkle, with 麗 beautiful as the sound), so it now means to sprinkle or spill.

洒.name: spill

垫.def: cushion, mat, pad; to advance money, to pay for another

origin.says: Simplified from 墊: 執 (to hold) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: to pad with earth, a cushion. 執 became 执.

垫.name: cushion

ety.hint: A hand 又(altered) holding an empty shell 甲 (altered)

origin.says: A hand holding an implement (often read as a fan) at the top: the servant who holds it, hence low, humble. Readings of the drawn object differ, and the parts are fused in the modern shape.

虏.def: prisoner; to capture, to imprison, to sieze

origin.says: Simplified from 虜: 虍 (tiger) as the sound plus a 'man' part (男 or 力 with a string of shells) for the meaning, a man taken captive. The simplified form keeps only 力 (strength) below.

虏.name: captive

俘.def: prisoner of war; take as prisoner

origin.says: 孚 (a hand over a child: to seize) was first written for 'capture'; 亻 (person) was added later: a person captured, a prisoner of war.

俘.name: war prisoner

筛.def: screen, sieve; to filter, to sift

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 师 (teacher) as the sound: a bamboo sieve, to sift. Simplified from 篩 along with 师.

筛.name: sift

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 胥 (assistant) as the sound: the man married to a daughter. Early forms had 士 (man) with another sound part.

睹.def: to look at, to gaze at; to observe

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: to see with one's eyes, to witness.

睹.name: witness

origin.says: Simplified from 饅: 食 (food) for the meaning plus 曼 (long) as the sound, with the food part written in the short form 饣: the steamed bun.

饪.def: cooked food; to cook until well-done

哄.def: to coax; to beguile, to cheat, to deceive; tumult, uproar

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 共 (together) as the sound: the noise of a crowd, uproar; to coax. It also replaces 鬨 (to fight, commotion).

哄.name: coax

ety.hint: Markings 文 in jade 王

origin.says: 文 (pattern) for the meaning set inside a shortened 班 (divide), whose two jades remain, as the sound: spotted, striped, mottled.
攵 (hand with a stick, marking action) for the meaning plus 尚 (esteem) as the sound: open, wide, spacious.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 末 (tip) as the sound: foam, froth, bubbles on water.
降 (descend) as the sound, with its lower foot dropped, plus 生 (grow) for the meaning: swelling up, abundant, grand.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 奂 as the sound: to call out to someone, to summon. Simplified from 喚 (奐 to 奂).
艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 曷 (why) as the sound: the kudzu vine, whose fibres were woven into cloth.

ety.hint: Metal 钅 that joins 连; 连 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 金 (metal) plus 連 (to link), which gives sound and meaning: a metal chain. Simplified from 鏈, with 钅 and 连.
Cut down from 悤: 囪 (chimney) as the sound plus 心 (heart). Part of 囪 and then the heart were dropped, leaving 匆: hurried. It is unrelated to 勿 (do not).

捞.def: to dredge up; to fish for; to scoop out of the water

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 勞 (toil) as the sound: to scoop something out of the water by hand. Simplified from 撈 like 劳.

捞.name: scoop out

origin.says: 章 (emblem) as the sound plus 彡 (colourful patterns) for the meaning: bright and striking, clear, manifest, to make known.

狩.def: winter hunting; a hunting dog; an imperial tour

origin.says: 匚 (box) for the meaning plus 非 (not) as the sound: first a bamboo basket; borrowed for its sound, it came to mean bandits.
酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus a sound part: to brew, to ferment. Simplified from 釀, whose sound part 襄 (to help) was replaced by 良 (good).
户 (door) plus 𠕁 (bamboo tablets, a form of 冊): a flat inscribed board on a door, hence flat and thin.
Simplified from 腸: 月 (flesh, body) for the meaning plus 昜 (sunlit) as the sound: the intestines. 昜 is written in its cursive shape 𠃓.

煎.def: to fry in fat or oil; to boil in water

origin.says: 前 (front) as the sound plus 灬 (fire) for the meaning: to fry in oil or boil down over a fire.

煎.name: pan-fry

origin.says: 毛 (fur, wool) for the meaning plus 炎 (blaze) as the sound: a woollen rug or blanket.

徙.def: to move, to shift; to migrate

ety.hint: To step 彳 out on a long journey 歨

origin.says: 彳 (step) with 止 (foot) above another foot shape: feet on the move, to migrate. Older forms used other sound parts; the modern shape is a worn-down walking sign.

徙.name: migrate

溉.def: to water, to irrigate, to flood; to wash

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 既 (already) as the sound: to water fields, to irrigate.

溉.name: water fields

戮.def: to kill, to massacre; to oppress
